title: Short title, for example: Why search traffic fell in October
headline: One or two sentences: what changed, by how much, the most likely driver, and when it started.
summary: Paragraph 1: the size of the change and whether it is unusual or seasonal.
Paragraph 2: where it is concentrated and what kind of change it is.
Paragraph 3: timing and what to look at first. Use 'coincides with', never 'caused by'.

sections.is_it_real: Answer first (yes, partly, or mostly tracking), then the evidence. Mention tracking issues in other sources separately.
sections.is_it_unusual: Compare the change with the typical range and with last year.
sections.where: Name the pages, queries or channels that account for most of the change, with their share.
sections.what_kind: Name the pattern in plain words and give the numbers behind it. Include the branded split if available.
sections.when: Give the date the trend shifted, the before and after averages, and the events it coincides with.
sections.next_checks: One short paragraph on where to start. The full list of checks is added automatically.
